reviews.text: We called Hart Pool to give us an estimate on a new pool pump. Alan and Rebecca in the office was super helpful and informative, they were able to schedule someone to come out and replace our pump in a very timely manner. Took our pool from green to clean in less than 72 hours. Highly recommend them for your pool needs.
reviews.author: Kristen English

reviews.text: I first moved to Fort Worth (far Southwest Fort Worth) at the end of July 2023 into a house with a pool and had no idea how to take care of it. I was looking for a certain brand of chlorine and only Hart Pool carried it. I met Alan there and he explained what I needed to do to take care of my pool. Alan remembered me and my son from the first day we walked in. Every time I have gone back, no matter what is going on with my pool or the questions I ask, they are always there to help. Never once have they seemed or been irritated with me or any other customer that has come in. Even though Hart Pool is located 30 miles from my house, and there are other pool supply stores closer to me, who may or may not have my chlorine brand now, I will only go to Hart. You are always greeted as soon as you walk in and you never leave without the help or supplies you need. Alan (and everyone else there) is truly amazing, friendly and always helpful. They always make you feel welcome. If you need any supplies for your pool, this is the place you need to go!
reviews.author: Jay McCain

reviews.text: What a wonderfully helpful local pool supply and repair shop! They saved us so much trouble, helping us fix up our Polaris 360 right there in person. It ran like a champ again, right after the in-store repair! We learned a lot just chatting during our visit.
reviews.author: Local Heroes

reviews.text: THIS after a return from a 5 week vacation; the filter element manifold had shattered, and the pool was a disaster, with grandkids coming in a few days.   I went to Hart to buy the part, Allen consulted with me on what to do and when, plus he reasembled my filter with the new part, and all of his guidance has been spot on.   And his DE price is by far the best deal around.  I am almost back to blue now, thanks Hart Team and Allen in particular!!!
reviews.author: Brett Flournoy

reviews.text: Our experience with Hart Pool for our pool and spa renovation was exceptional! The team demonstrated excellent communication, remarkable craftsmanship, and delivered the project on time and within budget. The final result exceeded our expectations, and their professionalism was evident throughout the entire process. HIGHLY recommend Hart Pool!
reviews.author: B. Haiden

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this company. They go out of their way to help diagnose and solve problems.  Alan and James are so helpful.  Hart is by far the best customer service around.
reviews.author: Rob W.

reviews.text:
Every time I have needed help with anything they always have expert advice. Parts for any part of my system they have had it. Given perfect advice on what part to change first before buying something I might not need.
When the front seal of our aux pump started leaking, again exact diagnosis, brought the pump in, seal changed works like a dream.
I can't say enough good things about every experience I have had there. Awesome people,  SHOP SMALL and LOCAL! I love supporting small businesses and these people are a shining example of why you should support small but expert shops . They will take care of you every time.
reviews.author: Frank Larson

reviews.text:
Highly recommend Hart Pool for equipment services and repair!  Pump went out, called Hart and Rebecca scheduled assessment, trouble shooting and repair same day!
Bo and Esau arrived on time, checked everything out and recommended a capacitor replacement as likely cause and first step. And it worked!  Total assessment and repair time 30 minutes. They could’ve easily just said pump bad, full replacement and significant costs. But nope, Hart is Customer First Focused and always strives to make only the service and repairs truly needed. I’ll only use Hart Pool for all my pool chemicals, services and repairs!
Thank you Rebecca and Hart Team!
reviews.author: Bob Ball
